title: Polaris Key kit copy, a locale pack (packages/brand/kit-copy/<locale>.json)
description: One launch locale's translation of en.json: the same keys, values only. packages/brand/scripts/kit-copy.ts checks the key set, the argument set and the locale's CLDR plural categories against en.json.

reviewed.description: false until a native speaker has reviewed the pack (a release follow-up, not a merge blocker).
